title: Record of a contribution in the registry
description: File: contributions/<project>/<task>-c<n>.yaml. Created by `bee submit`, completed by the CI (verdict), the reviewers (reviews) and the trusted workflow that integrates automatically (R3, no human) and sets aside the competing contributions of the same task (status « set_aside »).

summary_sha.description: Judged commit (verdict.sha) for which the author updated their summary (bee submit --update): one update per judged commit

engaged_since.description: Start of the author's engagement on the task (their reservation or their parallel registration), checked at submission; R3 uses it in races

tree.description: Git tree of the judged commit (verdicts.yml, GitHub API): an amended commit has the same content

base.description: Checked base of the verdict (ruche-0028): the reviewer reads compare/<base>...<sha>

verdicts.description: History of the verdicts (ruche-0028), from oldest to newest, written by the CI with each verdict: R4 and the ranking judge every green verdict of the same content (same tree, otherwise same sha); rerunning the CI can only hurt

dropped_verdicts.description: Verdicts dropped from the history (beyond 20): R4 then requires a measurement from another configuration

declared.description: Copied by the CI at the verdict (bee record-verdict --manifest, ruche-0017) from the manifest of the task and the author at the judged commit: fork data, bounded and typed (one line, invisible characters and what YAML would escape shown as <U+XXXX>, a finite gain, 12,000 characters written at most: bee validate); null if nothing was copied for this verdict; never written by a member

gain.description: Declared gain on the target metric (0.05 for 5 %)

opinion.description: abstention: with a reason (diff out of reach, conflict of interest, approach only); neither for nor against (R3, score), no point

confirmed_by.description: Who confirmed the defect: the CI, the council, a guardian or a Confirmed member, never the reviewer who reported it

tree.description: Tree of the judged commit reviewed (verdict.tree at the time of the review), if known

sha.description: Judged commit reviewed (verdict.sha at the time of the review); absent before the verdict: the review does not count for R3. One review per reviewer and per commit

lifts.description: The council's recourse (ruche-0012): the reviews of this reviewer published before the lift no longer weigh on this contribution, until they review again. Written by the council alone, in a reviewed PR

awaiting_verdict.description: Written by verdicts.yml (ruche-0025): why the head sha received no verdict (a code of bee's VERDICT_WAIT, whose sentence is rendered on display); not judged again before another head

never_integrated.description: Status « cancelled »: closed without ever being integrated (PR closed without merge); its favorable reviewers lose no point

kept.description: Status « set_aside »: the competing contribution of the same task that R3 kept in its place
